# Rukn Design System

> AI-ready, RTL-first design system for Arabic, Urdu, and multilingual web apps.

Rukn (رُكن / رکن) means "pillar" — structured primitives for AI agents and developers.

## Start here for agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/AGENTS.md): Agent entry point
- [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/DESIGN.md): Full agent guide, checklist, examples
- [components.json](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/components.json): Machine-readable component catalog

## Docs

- [COMPONENT_API.md](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/docs/COMPONENT_API.md): CSS classes + Web Component attributes
- [DESIGN_TOKENS.md](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/docs/DESIGN_TOKENS.md): Token reference
- [RTL_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/docs/RTL_GUIDE.md): Arabic / Urdu setup
- [types.d.ts](https://github.com/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem/blob/master/types.d.ts): TypeScript declarations

## Live

- [Home](https://ruknds.netlify.app/): Marketing + AI positioning
- [Components](https://ruknds.netlify.app/components.html): Live gallery
- [Foundation](https://ruknds.netlify.app/foundation.html): Tokens
- [Maktaba demo](https://ruknds.netlify.app/demo/maktaba.html): Arabic RTL e-commerce

## Install

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem@master/dist/rukn.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mfaizanatiq/RuknDesignSystem@master/dist/rukn.min.js" defer></script>
```

```bash
npm install @ruknds/core
```

## Rules for agents

1. Use only Rukn primitives (`btn-*`, `ds-*`, `rukn-*`)
2. Default to `class="dark"` on `<html>`
3. Set `lang` and `dir` for Arabic (`ar`/`rtl`) and Urdu (`ur`/`rtl`)
4. Use semantic tokens — never invent hex colors
5. Prefer `<rukn-navbar>` for app chrome
